title: Patient Services Guidance: Patient Financial Assistance Program Award Expiry and Invoice Holds While a Case Is Pending
content:
**Expiry.** An award under the Patient Financial Assistance Program expires on the day after its award end date. Invoices with later dates of service are billed in full unless a renewal is approved.

**Holds while a case is pending.** While a case is submitted, pending documents or under review, and the tier holds invoices during review, the patient's open invoices of the tier's billing classes are held from statements and collections for up to the invoices' assistance-review hold limit.

| Case status | Eligible open invoices held from statements and collections (where the tier holds invoices during review) |
|---|---|
| Submitted | Yes, up to the assistance-review hold limit |
| Pending documents | Yes, up to the assistance-review hold limit |
| Under review | Yes, up to the assistance-review hold limit |
| Approved, denied, withdrawn, expired, rescinded | Not under this guidance |

**Illustration (hypothetical dates).** An award's end date is 30 June. It expires on 1 July. An invoice for a date of service of 2 July is billed in full unless a renewal is approved.

**Provision no longer in force.** "Applications are taken through the tier's application channels only; an agent may take a phone-assisted application but records only the facts the applicant states and the documents received." This provision is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis.

superseded_clauses: Applications are taken through application_channels only; an agent may take a phone_assisted application but records only the facts the applicant states and the documents received.
